codeDefectsFixed: sl-inline-message painted a 2px navy host border AND a 2px ::before accent stripe; the design Banner is a flat borderless #ecf8ff fill. Removed via outer-tree host rules - no !important, no ::part, no shadow piercing. Background now resolves to exactly rgb(236,248,255).

All 8 table rows were 59px against the design 48px, compounding ~89px. Root cause was NOT the spec guess: sl-checkbox host is 32px (its touch target), and the last 1px was the collapsed row divider. Fixed with calc(token - borderWidth) padding; rows now exactly 48.
Card content column was 1118px not 1120px - the 1px card hairline was eating into it. Padding now pays for the border; card stays 1184 outer, 1120 inner.
remainingDiscrepancies: [DS-GAP] No 40px control size exists in itslearning: md is 36px (1lh + 2x --sl-size-100), lg is 48px (1lh + 2x --sl-size-175). The design uses 40px. Chose md because height error compounds down the page (md drifts the card 8px, lg 16px) while the Actions width error is local. Not forced with CSS.
[DS-GAP] Actions button 100.9px vs 114px wide - partly the md size, partly the accepted angle-down vs filled-caret glyph difference.
[DS-GAP] sl-checkbox host is 32px tall, which sets the FLOOR for the table row. A shorter row would need a change in sl-checkbox, not in this component.

[ENV] Font: the theme names Open Sans for every --sl-text-new-*-fontFamily and it does not load, so text renders in a fallback face. Measured document.body fontFamily is Lato - the design/s own font IS available in the browser; it is the theme/s font that is missing.
[TOKEN] Page title 24px vs the design 26px - itslearning has no 26px step (heading-lg 24, heading-xl 32).
[TOKEN] --600 #0b8356 (checked-checkbox fill) is genuinely unbound; sl-checkbox uses its own themed fill, so the three selected rows show purple where the design is green. Not overridden.

[ASSET] itslearning logo, your-files glyph, avatar photo and the four full-colour file-type glyphs are remote Figma assets. Rendered as correctly-sized empty boxes/discs. Never hand-drawn, never -linked.
[ICON] bell, comment and download are not among the 54 icons itslearning registers. Omitted with hit boxes preserved; no substitute glyph drawn.
[TOKEN] Disc fill #d9e3e8 has no token in ANY theme; nearest neutral --sl-color-palette-grey-200 used.
[TOKEN] Card shadow: design 0 4px 8px #0000000D; itslearning ships only -sm/-overlay/-overflow. --sl-elevation-shadow-sm used, offsets and colour differ.
[COLOR] Banner text is --sl-color-foreground-info-bold (navy) from the component; the design uses #333. Not overridden.

5-author.scope: examples/ path -> story enrichment only; no Vitest spec, no website docs, no changeset, no i18n extraction (per the pipeline skill example-path rule)
5-author.unreachableThroughPublicApi: selection, banner-dismissal, current page, page size and sort are all internal @state, so no story can set them. Covering them needs Storybook play functions, not new props. Recorded rather than worked around by widening the component API.

critical.what: Clear selection destroyed keyboard focus - the panel is torn out of the DOM and the focused button with it, dumping the user at <body>.
critical.how: #onClearSelection now awaits updateComplete and focuses sl-search-field (chosen over the first row checkbox because it always exists, even when the file list is empty, and lives in the root own shadow root).

critical.what: Pager prev/next disabled the focused button on reaching a bound, blurring to <body>.
critical.how: Swapped ?disabled for aria-disabled + an early return in the handler, so the button stays focusable and no-ops. Appearance byte-identical.

critical.what: selectedIds was never reconciled against data, so a data change left the component selecting ids that no longer exist (NoFiles showed a bulk panel over an empty table).
critical.how: willUpdate prunes selectedIds against data.files. NoFiles now hides the panel; Basic still renders the design literal 2 selected out of 40.

critical.what: Undisclosed reach-through: .card sl-inline-message::before { content: none } targets an undocumented implementation detail (inline-message paints its accent stripe with :host::before; there is no @csspart and no borderless API).
critical.resolution: ACCEPTED AND DISCLOSED, not removed. Removing it restores a 2px navy stripe the design does not have, which is a worse fidelity outcome. The cascade reasoning is sound (outer-tree rule beats :host, no !important needed) but the TARGET is private, so it would break silently if the stripe moved into a shadow element. The honest fix is a borderless/@csspart request on sl-inline-message.

detail: [ACCEPTED, undocumented target] course-files-pager.css [part=page-size] [slot=button] - sl-select advertises ::part(selected-option)/::part(selected)/::part(placeholder) in its JSDoc but they CANNOT match: select.ts:269 creates the button with shadowRoot.createElement then this.prepend(), so it lands in LIGHT DOM, and the package declares no exportparts. Needed because select-button.css hard-sets :host{color:--sl-color-foreground-plain} (#4a4a4a) where the design needs #333333. A documented API that does not work is a DS defect.
[ACCEPTED, undocumented target] course-files-page.css .card sl-inline-message::before {content:none} - see C3.
[SOFT] course-files-page.css .card sl-inline-message host override - legal outer-tree host styling, but its padding is reasoned against the component internal border-derived calc().
[LEGITIMATE] course-files-bulk-actions.css sl-button::part(button) - button is a documented @csspart.
[LEGITIMATE] course-files-pager.css [part=page-size] - plain host styling of sl-select.
reachThroughInventory.absent: No !important, no private --_* read or write, no ::slotted piercing, no >>> anywhere in the batch.

6-review.ariaSelectedRuling: NOT invalid - <tr> maps to role=row and ARIA 1.2 lists aria-selected among role row supported states, so axe will not fire. But it is INERT: the table role has no selection model. Do NOT promote to role=grid - that obligates full grid keyboard navigation which is not implemented and would be a worse a11y outcome. Actionable part fixed: the selected-row background now keys off tr[part~=row-selected] instead of the inert ARIA attribute.
